import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
audit=json.loads(Path("reports/T0012/review-r5/final-audit.json").read_text())
scope={"README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0012-proof-key.md","src/kmesh/logic/proof_key.py","tests/test_proof_key.py"}
names=[p for p in subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--cached","--name-only","-z"]).decode().split("\0") if p]
for name in names:
    assert name in scope or name.startswith("reports/T0012/"),name
    assert not {"pytest-tmp","__pycache__"}.intersection(Path(name).parts),name
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git","show",":"+name])==Path(name).read_bytes(),name
for name,digest in {**audit["accepted_files"],**audit["closure_document_sha256"],**audit["review_material_sha256"]}.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(["git","show",":"+name])).hexdigest()==digest,name
subprocess.run(["git","-c","core.whitespace=blank-at-eol,space-before-tab","diff","--cached","--check","--",*sorted(scope)],check=True)
print("PASS:",len(names),"staged files in task scope; all accepted/review hashes match; no scratch files")
print("Whitespace exception: retained raw evidence contains literal trailing whitespace/diff context; accepted test has a final empty line.")
print("Previous commit-staged-check failure preserved. Source and maintained docs pass blank-at-eol/space-before-tab checks.")
